title: LoloRP Mod
description: This project adds two new ores and a brand new sword...
body:
New adventures with LoloRP mod!
## **What's in this mod:**
- Two sets of ores: Silverton and Kristalium.
- Two sets of instruments(for each ore)
- The Roaring Knight's sword.
- Dark Steel

**This mod is more for my friends, but I wanted to add it to Modrinth because I think it's fun and pretty enjoyable!**
